name: setti
description: setti — fullstack React framework on React 19 + Fastify + Vite
author: yar.tema

scripts.publish:alpha: pnpm --filter setti build && pnpm --filter setti publish --tag alpha --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:beta: pnpm --filter setti build && pnpm --filter setti publish --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:latest: pnpm --filter setti build && pnpm --filter setti publish --tag latest --no-git-checks
scripts.version:alpha: pnpm --filter setti exec npm version prerelease --preid=alpha
scripts.version:patch: pnpm --filter setti exec npm version patch
scripts.version:minor: pnpm --filter setti exec npm version minor
scripts.version:major: pnpm --filter setti exec npm version major
